generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course applies to the work you are already doing. Every essay that builds an argument, every report that weighs competing evidence, every piece of writing judged on the quality of its reasoning draws on the moves you are about to practise. The students who learn to synthesise, judge and justify on the page are the ones whose writing earns its marks rather than merely covering the ground. Treat what follows as being about your own essays, reports and projects, not about study in the abstract.

The same capability runs through professional practice. Wherever you are asked to weigh evidence, reach a position and defend it in writing, the people who do it well are the ones who can argue a case with reasons. The craft you build here is one you keep long after you graduate.
